notes: Mandate-computed median of the 3 major agencies' GO bond ratings as of year-end 2015: Moody's Aa1 (9), Fitch AAA (10), S&P AAA (10) -- median 10. No rating action found for any agency in 2014-2016; treated as a continuation of Moody's July 2013 Aaa->Aa1 downgrade (MinnPost/Star Tribune coverage) and Fitch/S&P's then-AAA ratings.
Same as 2015: Moody's Aa1 (9), Fitch AAA (10), S&P AAA (10) -- median 10. No rating action found this year.

Mandate-computed median as of year-end 2017: Moody's Aa1 (9, outlook revised stable->negative Nov 8/13 2017 citing 'outsized and growing unfunded pension liabilities'), Fitch AA+ (9, downgraded from AAA on Nov 8, 2017 citing rising net pension liabilities of $1.5B), S&P AAA (10, unchanged) -- median 9.
Same as 2017: Moody's Aa1 (9, negative outlook), Fitch AA+ (9, stable), S&P AAA (10) -- median 9. No rating action found this year.
Same as 2017: Moody's Aa1 (9), Fitch AA+ (9), S&P AAA (10, confirmed via S&P's May 2019 rating report) -- median 9.

Year-end 2020: Moody's Aa1 (9), Fitch AA+ (9, affirmed stable per a Sept 2020 GO bond issuance), S&P AAA (10, outlook revised stable->negative Sept 9, 2020 citing COVID-19 budget pressure and financial exposure from the response to George Floyd's death, but rating itself unchanged) -- median 9.
Year-end 2021: Moody's Aa1 (9), Fitch AA+ (9, outlook revised stable->positive Oct 26, 2021), S&P AAA (10, outlook revised negative->stable Oct 26, 2021) -- median 9.
Year-end 2022: Moody's Aa1 (9, stable per Feb 2022 credit opinion), Fitch AA+ (9, positive outlook per Aug 2022 rating report), S&P AAA (10) -- median 9.

Year-end 2023: Moody's Aa1 (9, outlook revised stable->positive Nov 29, 2023 citing growing full value per capita and strengthening income), Fitch AAA (10, upgraded from AA+ Aug 8, 2023 citing moderating long-term liability burden from statewide pension reforms and population/income growth), S&P AAA (10) -- median 10.

Year-end 2024: Moody's Aaa (10, upgraded from Aa1 on Dec 18, 2024 citing sound financial management, multi-year budgeting, and growing property tax/state aid capacity), Fitch AAA (10), S&P AAA (10) -- median 10. All 3 agencies now at the top rating.

All 3 agencies confirmed AAA/Aaa (10) for 2025 -- City of Minneapolis press release 'City of Minneapolis earns AAA ratings from all three bond agencies for 2nd straight year' (Aug 2025); individual Aug 2025 S&P and Fitch rating reports and the GO Bond Series 2025 Official Statement confirm directly.
